title: session-load --paid passes only --allowedTools, so a paid session's tools are not limited to Read, git status and rag.py as its gate chose
goal: bench_load.paid_argv passes --tools Read,Bash and --permission-mode dontAsk beside its allow list of Read, git status and rag.py; the throwaway clone of every paid session has its .claude/settings.json permissions.allow replaced by that allow list; a paid clone's settings.json differs from the arm's own file in nothing but permissions.allow

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_load as b
T = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
bin_ = T / 'bin'; bin_.mkdir()
seen = T / 'seen'; seen.mkdir()
fake = bin_ / 'claude'
fake.write_text('#!/bin/sh\ncp .claude/settings.json %s/$$.json\necho \'{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"total_cost_usd":0,"session_id":"x"}\'\n' % seen)
fake.chmod(0o755)
os.environ['PATH'] = str(bin_) + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH']
real = json.load(open('.claude/settings.json'))
rules = ['Read', 'Bash(git status:*)', 'Bash(python3 _tools/rag.py:*)']
def clone_for(name):
    c = T / name; (c / '.claude').mkdir(parents=True)
    (c / '.claude' / 'settings.json').write_text(json.dumps(real, indent=2) + '\n')
    for a in (('init', '-q'), ('add', '-A'), ('-c', 'user.name=t', '-c', 'user.email=t', 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'x')):
        subprocess.run(['git', *a], cwd=c, check=True, capture_output=True)
    return c
class FB:
    scratch = T / 'scratch'; cc = '?'
FB.scratch.mkdir()
def hooks_of(arm):
    left = ('coord_hook.py', 'querylog.py') if arm == 'C' else ()
    out = {}
    for ev, groups in real.get('hooks', {}).items():
        kept = [dict(g, hooks=[h for h in g['hooks'] if not any(x in h.get('command', '') for x in left)]) for g in groups]
        kept = [g for g in kept if g['hooks']]
        if kept:
            out[ev] = kept
    return out
try:
    for arm in ('A', 'C', 'D', 'worker'):
        for f in seen.glob('*.json'):
            f.unlink()
        b.paid_group(FB, [clone_for('c-' + arm)], arm, 'idle', 0)
        got = [json.loads(f.read_text()) for f in seen.glob('*.json')]
        assert len(got) == 1, ('arm ' + arm + ': the planted claude ran %d times' % len(got))
        s = got[0]
        assert s.get('permissions', {}).get('allow') == rules, ('arm ' + arm + ': the clone keeps allow rules beyond the paid allow list', len(s.get('permissions', {}).get('allow', [])))
        rest = lambda d: {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k not in ('hooks', 'permissions')}
        assert rest(s) == rest(real) and s.get('permissions', {}).get('deny') == real['permissions'].get('deny'), ('arm ' + arm + ': the clone settings differ from the arm file beyond permissions.allow',)
        assert s.get('hooks', {}) == hooks_of(arm), ('arm ' + arm + ': the clone hooks are not the arm hooks',)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
